verdict.rationale: Windows' own support documentation includes a 'Keyboard shortcuts in Windows' page, so first-party hotkey support exists. The pack is only a page title, though, with no detail on how much of the system the shortcuts cover. Nothing documents a keyboard-driven launcher, and Snap layouts are mentioned without any keyboard operation. Missing for 10: documented keyboard-driven launcher, evidence that the entire system is operable by keyboard alone, keyboard control of window management, independent or hands-on corroboration.
